To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

network virtualization is an umbrella term that covers a broad set of techniques that can be applied to different network domains and that can be used to enable different types of network architectures.

1) network virtualization is a technology to create multiple virtual networks on a shared substrate, 2) the virtual networks are created using a set of virtualization technologies, 3) the virtualization technologies are based on virtual network abstractions, 4) the virtual network abstractions are based on virtualization mechanisms, and 5) the virtualization mechanisms are based on virtual networking primitives.
Network virtualization refers, broadly speaking, to the ability to create and manage multiple isolated virtual networks on top of a physical network infrastructure.
In summary, our research is concerned with
network virtualization as an enabling technology for network research, deployment, experimentation and innovation.

understanding the fundamental properties and limitations of network virtualization, and with developing a set of design principles and guidelines to guide the development of network virtualization technologies.

the field of network virtualization is still in its infancy and that the research community should continue to explore the frontiers of the technology.
network virtualization is a set of technologies and approaches that enable the co-existence of multiple virtual networks on a shared physical substrate.
network virtualization is an emerging technology that is likely to have a significant impact on the future of networking.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
network virtualization is an enabling technology that is likely to have a significant impact on networking research, experimentation, and deployment.
we are witnessing the emergence of a new generation of network architectures that is enabled by virtualization.
network virtualization is a broad and powerful set of technologies that can enable a wide range of applications.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the network virtualization research community is at a point of transition, and it is time to take stock and identify commonalities, as well as challenges and opportunities, in the field.
the term “network” in the context of virtualization is a misnomer: it is the network that is virtual, but not necessarily the network that is being virtualized.
network virtualization is not just a set of technologies, but a new perspective on networking, one that will enable a wide range of new research directions and opportunities.
